title: Asset
description: A cloud infrastructure resource with observed configuration properties at a point in time.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier. For AWS: full ARN. For on-prem: vendor-defined URN.

type.description: Asset type in snake_case. Defines which controls can evaluate this asset.

vendor.description: Infrastructure vendor. Determines which extractor produced this asset.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this asset state was observed. Immutable after capture.

region.description: Geographic or logical region. AWS region, vSphere datacenter, etc.

account_id.description: Account or organization unit that owns this asset.

tags.description: Key-value metadata tags as set on the asset in the source system.

sensitivity.description: Data sensitivity classification. Amplifies risk scores on findings.

properties.description: Configuration properties specific to this asset type. CEL predicates in controls reference fields within properties.
